verdict.rationale: Glama documents web-driven hosting, where it builds a server from a connected GitHub repo, and copy-paste config blocks for installing servers into clients. Nothing in the evidence shows an official CLI that authenticates, builds or stages, pushes, or installs servers into agents. The OpenAPI directory API and the mcp-proxy tunnel are adjacent building blocks, not a publish-and-deploy CLI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the publish-and-deploy workflow from an official CLI — authenticate, stage or build a server, push it, and install it into agents
